name: Andi Saputera
title: Implementation Specialist
bio: Implementation Specialist and System Analyst with experience in healthcare information systems, business process analysis, system implementation, UAT, user training, and digital transformation.
aboutLong: Implementation Specialist and System Analyst with experience in healthcare information systems (SIMRS), business process analysis, and system implementation. Skilled in gathering user requirements, mapping business workflows, translating operational needs into functional requirements, and validating system functionality through testing and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

Experienced in collaborating with users and development teams throughout system configuration, implementation, go-live, and post-implementation support. Interested in system analysis, business process improvement, and delivering practical technology solutions that align with business needs.
